lines.text: Lily bought a cheap water-resistant jacket for a rainy fall hike.
An hour in, the shoulders soaked through, and she was damp inside from sweat too.
Here's how to choose a waterproof hiking jacket.
Waterproof means taped seams and a membrane that keeps rain out.
Breathable means sweat vapor can escape, so open the vents when you climb.
Water-resistant only handles a light drizzle.
Lily's new shell kept her dry all day.
Save this before your next rainy hike.
